entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 10% off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.

Portugal in November sounds lovely, and a two-week trip with your wife is a good reason for a new carry-on. What matters most to you in choosing one: size for the airline, how it looks, or how sturdy it is?
Most it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Heavy bags are no fun, especially for two weeks of travel. Have you looked at any other stores or brands for a carry-on, like Amazon?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something had cost but the Bugatti looks nicer.
Samsonite on Amazon, and the Bugatti simply looks nicer to you. Good to know. What would make you buy it today, or what's holding you back?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And is fast enough before the trip.
I'll highlight the size details on the page for you. For delivery time, I don't have a firm estimate, so the shipping policy page is the place to check before November.
Once you've got the exact size, you can check it against Air Transat's carry-on limit. How did you first find HeliumDeploy?
I saw an ins to grammar a few days ago. That's how I found you.
An Instagram ad a few days ago, thanks. That's really helpful, and I hope the dimensions work out for your Portugal trip. Your code will appear on screen as soon as you press "End call". Goodbye!
Actually, one last thing before you go. What is it about the Bugatti's look that you like better than the Samsonite?
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
Thank you! Press "End call" to see your code. Safe travels!
